dict.string: Daily Workspace shows your calendar and lets you create, edit, and delete events when you choose.
Daily Workspace shows your calendar and lets you create, edit, and delete events when you choose.
Daily Workspace shows your reminders and lets you add and complete them when you choose.
Read flagged Mail metadata when you enable it, control Music, or request a restart only when you choose those actions.
Restart Bluetooth only when you choose BT Restart in the quick panel.
When you tap Dictate question, Daily Workspace listens to fill your Assistant draft until you stop dictation or leave the Assistant. Nothing is sent until you choose Ask.
When you tap Dictate question, Daily Workspace uses on-device speech recognition to put words in your Assistant draft. Recognition is unavailable rather than using a remote transcription service.
